summary: Gorax reviews the Reversal Summon banner featuring the limited hero Child of Chaos and conducts a 700-dice summon session. He explains that 1 copy of Child of Chaos is sufficient for most players, while a second copy unlocks his powerful exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst. New players are advised to prioritize securing core DPS heroes from Option Summons before going all-in on limited support banners. Throughout the pulls, Gorax gives verdicts on several legendary heroes including Gillian, Sagomir, Oggok, Ripekas, Quaesitia, Solmo, and Donella.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Element-switching support providing healing, immunity, and damage or damage reduction via his exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst; 1 copy is sufficient for most players.

heroes.name: Gillian
heroes.note: Dispels debuffs, grants Defense Up II, provides damage reduction, and shares resistance across the team.

heroes.name: Sagomir
heroes.note: Accelerates dungeon clears by granting ultimate energy to allies, taunting enemies, and applying attack penalty.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.verdict: top tier support for Toxic and Temporal Vortex
heroes.note: Grants immortality, strong healing, dispels, and attack penalty; widely used by veteran players.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Outperforms many exclusive supports by providing massive shields, debuff immunity, and Defense Up II.

heroes.name: Ripekas
heroes.verdict: great crowd control support for Fey Meander and PvP
heroes.note: Offers strong crowd control with knock-up and stun, ultimate steal, and multiple debuffs.

heroes.name: Quaesitia
heroes.verdict: strong PvP and Fey Meander disruptor
heroes.note: Pulls enemies towards herself to disrupt enemy formations while dealing necrotic damage.

heroes.name: Donella
heroes.note: No longer useful as newer heroes fulfill her healing prohibition role much more effectively.

heroes.name: Talwer
heroes.note: Currently lacks practical utility, making his copies best used for artifact conversion currency.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Mainly serves as duplicate fodder to exchange for shop artifacts.

meta_changes: New limited support hero Child of Chaos introduced with element-switching mechanics and team-wide damage buffs via his exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst.
tips: Stop pulling on the Child of Chaos banner after 1 copy, or 2 copies if you want to unlock his exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst.
New players should prioritize getting core DPS heroes from Option Summons before investing heavily into limited support banners.
Solmo and Oggok are extremely high-value non-exclusive supports worth investing in for endgame content like Temporal Vortex.
title: I Went ALL IN for Child of Chaos… Should You Pull? | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
